item: The pass records its deferred sources by identity, so an exhausted pool cannot lose their run-first claim
summary: Found by the second Opus read of #1439; it is the F3 listed as low risk, which I had wrong (I said the ids were loaded). The pass records the sources it deferred in a finally, as objects of the caller's session; the first commit or rollback expires them, and source.id on an expired instance reloads the row through a pooled connection. With the pool exhausted that timed out inside the finally: the pass ended as a failure although its body had finished, and nothing was recorded, so the deferred sources lost their run-first claim (it also cost one SELECT per deferred source on a healthy pool). The ids now come from the identity the session already holds (_source_key). Red without: a sequential pass with a stop asked after the first source's commit and the next checkout from run_scrape_once timing out: unfixed it raises from the finally, fixed it reports 3 deferred and keeps them as carried over.
